FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Good questions.
A more confident decision.

Planning a new entrance or improving an existing gate? Start with the essentials, then talk with us about your property.

How much does an automatic gate cost?+

Pricing depends on the gate design, opening size, materials, operator, access controls, and site preparation. A conversation about your property followed by an assessment is the best way to establish a meaningful quote.

How long does installation take?+

Timing depends on the scope, design decisions, site conditions, equipment availability, and any required approvals. Ask for a project-specific schedule after the entrance and system have been assessed.

Are automatic gates secure?+

A well-planned gate can help manage vehicle access, but no gate makes a property immune to intrusion. Gate design, access controls, and other security measures should be considered together.

What types of gates can I discuss with Big Bear?+

Discuss swing or sliding configurations, your preferred materials and finish, and the look of your entrance. The appropriate options depend on available space, site conditions, and the project scope.

Do you repair existing gate systems?+

Contact Big Bear with the gate and operator details and a description of the issue. Equipment compatibility, repair scope, and service availability need to be confirmed for your system.

Can an existing gate be automated?+

Some existing gates can be suitable for automation. Their condition, structure, weight, movement, and available power must be assessed before deciding whether automation is appropriate.

Which access controls should I consider?+

Keypads, remotes, and intercoms serve different access needs. Start with who needs to enter, how often, and how visitors or deliveries should be handled. Connectivity and compatibility also affect the choice.

Where does Big Bear work?+

Big Bear Automatic Gates, LLC is based in LaBelle, Florida. Share your property location when you call or request a quote so service availability can be confirmed.

What should I prepare for a consultation?+

Your property location, photos of the entrance, an approximate opening width, and your main goals are useful. For an existing system, include the operator brand and model if available.
